If set to `false`, will prevent rendering to a path that already exists. Default is `true`.

## CLI flag

Use `--overwrite` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                             | Flag          |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)               | `--overwrite` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                 | `--overwrite` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)         | `--overwrite` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render) | `--overwrite` |
